evidence.quote: With effect from 2 February 2026, STREAMS 2 will become the only channel for filing STRs2. Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:
upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.

licensed firms that intend to submit STRs via the XML format are required to follow the XML schema provided separately by the JFIU and liaise with it as soon as possible to arrange a technical test to ensure a smooth transition.
for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;
For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2.

lost_or_added_conditions: No executable preservation is demonstrated: the sole child has null formalization and is UNENCODED with E_UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE. Actor, filing-event scope, temporal scope, method alternatives, certificate attachment and unknown-value handling survive only in prose.
The parent expression uses undeclared is_xml_submission. Neither that defect nor the missing XML schema is resolved by the proposal.
The certificate requirement remains attached only to XML and prescribed PDF, without an added web-form requirement; its operational satisfaction conditions remain unspecified.
Equating implementation with the inclusive 9:00am launch boundary remains an interpretation. The date-level effective provision and the unspecified timezone are not conclusively resolved.

Blackout urgent contact and mandatory resubmission after an off-channel filing remain prose residuals, not executable obligations. A later compliant filing cannot by itself establish discharge of a particular earlier filing's resubmission duty.
The XML technical-test liaison duty is outside the selected filing control in both versions; neither version establishes compliance with that separate source obligation.
value.rationale: The child's prose substantially retains the parent's limited, mandatory filing control and expressly acknowledges unresolved conditions. However, the actual child supplies no executable scope or satisfaction expression, so correspondence cannot be established. The supplied authorities support the channel, method and certificate requirements but do not supply the referenced XML schema or settle every temporal and certificate-assessment question. An opaque compliance predicate would not cure those gaps. This is an absence of demonstrated executable preservation, rather than a demonstrated substantive reversal.
